items.title: 形近义异词辨析
items.brief: 按词性与句法位置区分形近词

concept.summary: 形近词的拼写只差一两个字母，但词性和意义不同，判定依据是句法位置：空格前有冠词、形容词或物主代词时需要名词，空格后直接带宾语时需要动词。按词性先定类，再按词义选词，比凭语感可靠。affect/effect、advice/advise、principal/principle 的差别都是词性差别，adapt/adopt、compliment/complement 的差别则是同词性下的词义差别。

sections.p: affect 只作动词，意为“影响”；effect 通常作名词，意为“影响、效果”，作动词时只表示“实现、促成”。adapt 表示“使适应、改编”，常与 to 搭配；adopt 表示“采纳、收养”，宾语是方案、政策或孩子。
bullets: √ The noise affected her concentration. / × The noise effected her concentration.
√ The new rule had little effect on sales. / × The new rule had little affect on sales.
√ Children adapt quickly to a new school. / × Children adopt quickly to a new school.
√ The team adopted a new strategy. / × The team adapted a new strategy.

sections.p: principal 既可作形容词“主要的”，也可作名词“校长、本金”；principle 只有名词用法，意为“原则、原理”。advice 是不可数名词，不能加 s 或 a；advise 是动词，常用 advise sb to do 或 advise doing。
bullets: √ the principal reason / the school principal；× the principle reason
√ He refused on principle. / × He refused on principal.
√ She gave me a piece of advice. / × She gave me an advice.
√ I advise you to check the figures. / × I advice you to check the figures.

sections.p: compliment 是“赞美、恭维”，常用 pay sb a compliment；complement 是“补充、与…相配”，常用 complement each other。desert 作名词重音在第一音节，意为“沙漠”；作动词重音在第二音节，意为“抛弃”。dessert 只作名词，意为“甜点”，重音在第二音节。
bullets: √ Her scarf complements her coat. / × Her scarf compliments her coat.
√ He paid her a compliment on her speech.
√ Few plants survive in the desert. / √ He deserted his family.
√ We had ice cream for dessert. / × We had ice cream for desert.

examples.en: The long delay affected the whole schedule.
examples.zh: 长时间延误影响了整个进度。
examples.note: affect 是动词，直接带宾语 the whole schedule。

examples.en: The long delay effected the whole schedule.
examples.zh: 长时间延误影响了整个进度。
examples.note: effect 作动词意为“实现、促成”，不表示“影响”，应改为 affected。

examples.en: The school adopted a new policy on homework.
examples.zh: 学校采纳了一项新的作业政策。
examples.note: adopt 表示采纳政策、方案，宾语是 policy。

examples.en: The school adapted a new policy on homework.
examples.zh: 学校采纳了一项新的作业政策。
examples.note: adapt 是“使适应、改编”，采纳政策必须用 adopt。

examples.en: She gave me some advice about the interview.
examples.zh: 她给了我一些面试方面的建议。
examples.note: advice 是不可数名词，用 some 直接修饰。

examples.en: She advised me to apply for the job.
examples.zh: 她建议我申请这份工作。
examples.note: advise 是动词，构成 advise sb to do。

examples.en: This wine complements the fish perfectly.
examples.zh: 这款葡萄酒和这道鱼非常相配。
examples.note: complement 表示食物、风格之间的互补与相配。

examples.en: The principle reason for the delay was the weather.
examples.zh: 延误的主要原因是天气。
examples.note: principle 只作名词“原则”，形容词“主要的”是 principal。

pitfalls.wrong: The weather effected our travel plans.
pitfalls.right: The weather affected our travel plans.
pitfalls.why: effect 作动词只表示“实现、促成”，表示“影响”必须用 affect。

pitfalls.wrong: He gave me a good advice.
pitfalls.right: He gave me a good piece of advice.
pitfalls.why: advice 是不可数名词，数量必须由量词 piece 承担。

pitfalls.wrong: The two colours compliment each other.
pitfalls.right: The two colours complement each other.
pitfalls.why: compliment 是“赞美”，complement 才是“相互补充、相配”。

contrast.diff: 形近词的词义本身不同，靠词性与拼写区分；义近词意义相近，差别在句法槽位与搭配。

concept.mnemonic: affect 动、effect 名；adapt 适应、adopt 采纳；principal 主要、principle 原则；advice 名、advise 动。

core: affect 动词“影响”；effect 名词“效果”，作动词意为“实现”
adapt to 适应、adapt 改编；adopt 采纳、收养
principal 形容词“主要的”或名词“校长”；principle 只作名词“原则”
advice 不可数名词；advise 动词，接 sb to do
compliment 赞美；complement 补充、相配
desert 沙漠/抛弃；dessert 甜点
review.trigger: 看到形近词 → 先看空格前后需要什么词性 → 再按词义二选一

quickCheck.q: “采纳建议”用 adopt 还是 adapt？
effect 作动词是什么意思？

drills.stem: The new traffic rules will ___ every driver in the city.
drills.answer: affect
drills.explain: will 后需要动词原形，句意为“影响每一位司机”，表示影响用 affect。
drills.trap: effect 形近且可作动词，但词义是“实现、促成”，不能表示“影响”。

drills.stem: The children soon ___ to their new school and made friends. (adapt)
drills.answer: adapted
drills.hint: 后面的 to 是介词，动词表示“适应”；注意与 soon 配合的时态。
drills.explain: adapt to 表示“适应”，与过去时 made 并列，须用 adapted。

drills.stem: She gave me an advice about choosing a major.
drills.answer: She gave me a piece of advice about choosing a major.
accept: She gave me a piece of advice about choosing a major.
drills.explain: advice 是不可数名词，不能直接加 a，数量由 a piece of 承担。

drills.stem: The two designers' styles ___ each other beautifully.
drills.answer: complement
drills.explain: complement 表示两者相互补充、相配，主语 styles 是复数，谓语用原形。
drills.trap: compliment 意为“赞美”，不能描述风格之间的互补关系。

drills.stem: 校长原则上同意了这个方案。
drills.answer: The principal agreed to the plan in principle.
drills.explain: “校长”是 principal，“原则上”是固定短语 in principle，两个词形近但词性不同。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The desert covers a large part of the country.
drills.explain: desert 作名词意为“沙漠”，covers 是谓语，a large part of 是宾语。

items.title: 义近用法异词辨析
items.brief: 按句法槽位区分义近词

concept.summary: 义近词的差别不在词典释义，而在句法槽位：能不能带人、能不能带 to、后面接内容还是接对象。say 的宾语是说话内容，tell 必须先出现“人”，speak 接语言或用于 speak to sb，talk 不及物。listen 与 look 是主动动作，必须带 to/at；hear 与 see 是感知结果，不带介词。join 接组织，attend 接活动，take part in 强调参与。

sections.p: 四者的分工由宾语类型决定：say sth (to sb) 的宾语是内容；tell sb sth / tell sb to do 必须先出现人；speak 接语言或用于 speak to sb about sth；talk 不及物，用 talk to/with sb about sth。
bullets: √ She said nothing to me. / × She said me nothing.
√ He told me the truth. / × He told that he was late.（→ He said that he was late.）
√ She speaks three languages. / × She talks three languages.
√ We talked about the plan for an hour. / × We talked the plan.

sections.h: listen / hear 与 look / see / watch
sections.p: listen 与 look 是主动动作，强调“把注意力投过去”，必须与 to/at 连用；hear 与 see 是感知结果，不接介词；watch 强调对动态对象的持续注视，宾语通常是比赛、节目或孩子。
bullets: √ I listened to the lecture carefully. / × I listened the lecture.
√ I heard a strange noise outside. / × I heard to a strange noise.
√ She looked at the photo for a long time. / √ She saw a familiar face in the crowd.
√ We watched the match on TV. / × We looked the match on TV.

sections.p: join 接组织、团体，表示成为其中一员；attend 接会议、课程、婚礼等活动，只表示出席；take part in 接活动，强调参与其中并出力。join in 多用于口语中的临时活动。
bullets: √ He joined the army in 2018. / × He attended the army.
√ She attended a conference in Vienna. / × She joined a conference.
√ Twenty students took part in the debate.（参与辩论）/ √ Two hundred people attended the debate.（到场旁听）
× He took part in the club. → joined the club

examples.en: She said that she would be late.
examples.zh: 她说她会迟到。
examples.note: say 后接说话内容，可以带 that 从句。

examples.en: She said me that she would be late.
examples.zh: 她告诉我她会迟到。
examples.note: say 不能带“人”作宾语，须改为 told me 或 said to me。

examples.en: He told us an interesting story.
examples.zh: 他给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。
examples.note: tell 必须带人作宾语，构成 tell sb sth。

examples.en: He spoke English throughout the interview.
examples.zh: 整个面试过程中他都说英语。
examples.note: speak 后接语言名称。

examples.en: We talked about the schedule for half an hour.
examples.zh: 我们讨论日程讨论了半小时。
examples.note: talk 不及物，用 about 引出话题。

examples.en: I listened to the podcast on my way to work.
examples.zh: 我在上班路上听了播客。
examples.note: listen 是主动动作，必须带介词 to。

examples.en: She attended three conferences last year.
examples.zh: 她去年参加了三场会议。
examples.note: attend 接会议，表示出席。

examples.en: She took part in the student union last year.
examples.zh: 她去年加入了学生会。
examples.note: 学生会是组织，成为成员用 join；take part in 只接活动。

pitfalls.wrong: He said me to wait outside.
pitfalls.right: He told me to wait outside.
pitfalls.why: say 不能带人称宾语，命令某人做某事用 tell sb to do。

pitfalls.right: I listened to the teacher carefully.
pitfalls.why: listen 是不及物动词，必须由 to 引出听的对象。

pitfalls.wrong: She took part in the student union last year.
pitfalls.right: She joined the student union last year.
pitfalls.why: take part in 接活动，成为组织成员用 join。

contrast.diff: 义近词的差别在接不接人、接不接 to 等句法槽位；方向动词的差别在动作朝向哪个参照点。

concept.mnemonic: say 内容、tell 人、speak 语言、talk 交流；listen/look 加 to/at，hear/see 不加工。

core: say sth (to sb)：宾语是内容，不能 say sb sth
tell sb sth / tell sb to do：必须带人
speak + 语言；speak to sb about sth
talk to/with sb about sth，talk 不及物
listen to / look at 是主动动作；hear / see 是感知结果
join 组织、attend 活动、take part in 参与
review.trigger: 看到“说/听/看/参加”类动词 → 先看它后面有没有人、有没有 to/at → 再定词

quickCheck.q: “告诉我真相”用 say 还是 tell？

drills.stem: She ___ me that the meeting had been cancelled.
drills.answer: told
drills.explain: 空格后先出现人 me，再出现说话内容 that 从句，符合 tell sb that 从句的结构。
drills.trap: said 不能带人称宾语，若用 said 必须改成 said to me。

drills.stem: Nobody ___ me why the class had been moved. (tell)
drills.answer: told
drills.hint: tell 必须带人作宾语，注意与 had been moved 的时态配合。
drills.explain: tell 的结构是 tell sb sth，此处宾语是 me，主句动作发生在过去，用 told。

drills.stem: He said me that he had finished the report.
drills.answer: He told me that he had finished the report.
accept: He told me that he had finished the report.
drills.explain: say 不能带人称宾语，改为 tell 后才能接 me，构成 tell sb that 从句。

drills.stem: More than three hundred people ___ the opening ceremony yesterday.
drills.answer: attended
drills.explain: 开幕式是活动，表示出席用 attend，且 yesterday 要求过去式。
drills.trap: join 接组织、团体；take part in 强调参与活动并出力，与“到场出席”语义不同。

drills.stem: 她告诉我她下个月要去上海。
drills.answer: She told me that she was going to Shanghai the next month.
drills.explain: tell 必须带人，said 不能带 me；主句为过去时，从句用过去将来时 was going to。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I listened to the radio while I was cooking.
drills.explain: listen 是不及物动词，必须带介词 to；while 引导的时间状语从句用过去进行时表背景。

items.title: 数量词辨析
items.brief: 名词可数性与冠词决定数量词

concept.summary: 数量词的选择由两个变量决定：名词可不可数，以及限定词有没有 a。amount 计量不可数的量，number 计量可数的个数；few/little 前的 a 决定肯定还是否定；many 接可数复数，much 接不可数。判定顺序是先看名词能否计数，再看限定词是否带 a。

sections.p: amount 计量不可数的量，number 计量可数的个数；a great amount of 接不可数，a great number of 接可数复数。the number of 作主语谓语用单数，a number of 作主语谓语用复数。
bullets: √ a large amount of money / × a large amount of coins
√ a large number of students / × a large number of water
√ The number of applicants is rising. / √ A number of applicants are waiting.
× The number of students are increasing.

sections.h: few / a few 与 little / a little
sections.p: few 与 little 表示“几乎没有”，是否定含义；a few 与 a little 表示“有一些”，是肯定含义。few/a few 接可数复数，little/a little 接不可数。only 后只能接 a few / a little。
bullets: √ Few students passed the test.（几乎没有）/ √ A few students passed the test.（有一些）
√ There is little water left. / × There are little water left.
√ I have a little time this afternoon. / × I have a few time.
√ Only a few seats are left.

sections.h: many / much 与 a lot of
sections.p: many 接可数复数，much 接不可数，二者多用于否定句与疑问句；肯定句中常用 a lot of 或 plenty of，两者皆可。much 还可修饰比较级，表示“得多”，此时不表示数量。
bullets: √ How many books did you buy? / × How much books did you buy?
√ There isn't much milk left. / √ There are lots of chairs in the hall.
√ He is much taller than his brother.
× Much students agree with the plan. → Many students

examples.en: A large amount of money was spent on the bridge.
examples.zh: 这座桥花费了大量资金。
examples.note: amount 接不可数名词 money，谓语用单数 was。

examples.en: A large amount of coins were found in the box.
examples.zh: 盒子里发现了大量硬币。
examples.note: coins 是可数复数，须用 a large number of。

examples.en: Few of the applicants had the required experience.
examples.zh: 几乎没有申请人具备所需的经验。
examples.note: few 是否定含义，表示“几乎没有”。

examples.en: A few of the applicants had the required experience.
examples.zh: 有几个申请人具备所需的经验。
examples.note: a few 是肯定含义，表示“有几个”。

examples.en: There is little hope of finishing on time.
examples.zh: 按时完成的希望渺茫。
examples.note: little 接不可数名词 hope，含否定意义。

examples.en: There are little hope of finishing on time.
examples.zh: 按时完成的希望渺茫。
examples.note: little 接不可数名词，谓语须用单数 is。

examples.en: The number of visitors has doubled this year.
examples.zh: 今年游客数量翻了一番。
examples.note: the number of 的中心词是 number，谓语用单数 has。

pitfalls.wrong: A number of water was wasted.
pitfalls.right: A large amount of water was wasted.
pitfalls.why: a number of 只修饰可数复数，water 不可数，须改用 amount。

pitfalls.wrong: He has few money but many friends.
pitfalls.right: He has little money but many friends.
pitfalls.why: money 不可数，须用 little；friends 是可数复数，用 many。

pitfalls.wrong: The number of students are increasing.
pitfalls.right: The number of students is increasing.
pitfalls.why: the number of 的中心词是 number，谓语用单数。

contrast.withTitle: 不可数名词的量化表达
contrast.diff: 量化表达讲“用量词把不可数名词数出来”；本知识点讲“限定词与名词可数性、肯定否定的匹配”。

concept.mnemonic: amount 不可数、number 可数；有 a 是肯定，没 a 是否定；few 接复数、little 接不可数。

core: amount 接不可数，number 接可数复数
the number of 谓语用单数；a number of 谓语用复数
few/little 是否定含义；a few/a little 是肯定含义
few/a few 接可数复数，little/a little 接不可数
many 接可数复数，much 接不可数，也修饰比较级
only 后接 a few / a little，不接 few / little
review.trigger: 看到数量词 → 先看后面的名词可不可数 → 再看限定词有没有 a

quickCheck.q: a number of 与 the number of 的谓语分别是什么？

drills.stem: A large ___ of information was collected during the survey.
drills.answer: amount
drills.explain: information 是不可数名词，只能由 amount 计量，谓语 was 也印证了单数中心词。
drills.trap: number 只接可数复数；many 与 few 直接修饰名词，不能构成 a large ___ of 结构。

drills.stem: There is ___ hope that the missing climbers will be found alive.
drills.answer: little
drills.hint: hope 不可数，句意为“几乎没有”。
drills.explain: hope 是不可数名词，表示“几乎没有”用 little，谓语 is 也要求单数中心词。

drills.stem: The number of tourists visiting the island are increasing every year.
drills.answer: The number of tourists visiting the island is increasing every year.
accept: The number of tourists visiting the island is increasing every year.
drills.explain: the number of 作主语时中心词是 number，谓语须用单数 is，不受后面 tourists 影响。

drills.stem: Only ___ of the thirty students failed, so the class average was high.
drills.answer: a few
drills.explain: only 后只能接 a few 或 a little；students 可数复数，故用 a few。
drills.trap: few 是否定含义“几乎没有”，不能与 only 连用；little 接不可数名词。

drills.stem: 今年游客的数量翻了一番。
drills.answer: The number of tourists has doubled this year.
drills.explain: the number of 的中心词是 number，谓语用单数 has；a number of 才表示“许多”，谓语用复数。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: A large number of students volunteered for the event.
drills.explain: a large number of 接可数复数 students，谓语按语义一致用复数 volunteered。

items.title: 动作方向动词辨析
items.brief: 按参照点与往返判断方向动词

concept.summary: 方向动词的差别由参照点决定：bring 朝说话人或听者移动，take 离开说话人移向别处，fetch 是“去取再回来”的往返；borrow 是借入，lend 是借出；come 朝说话人或听者，go 是离开。判断时先定位参照点，再看动作是单向还是往返，最后看主语是取得者还是给出者。

sections.p: bring 表示把某物带到说话人或听者所在处；take 表示从说话人所在处带走；fetch 表示去某处取来并返回，含两段路程。句中出现 here、me 时优先 bring，出现 there、away 时优先 take。
bullets: √ Please bring your notebook to class tomorrow.（带到上课地点）
√ Take an umbrella with you; it may rain.（从这里带走）
√ Could you fetch me a glass of water?（去取再回来）
× Please take your notebook here tomorrow. → bring

sections.p: borrow 的主语是借入者，结构为 borrow sth from sb；lend 的主语是借出者，结构为 lend sb sth 或 lend sth to sb。同一件事从两端描述，主语与介词都相反。
bullets: √ I borrowed a bike from my neighbour. / × I borrowed my neighbour a bike.
√ She lent me her notes. / √ She lent her notes to me.
× He borrowed me his car. → He lent me his car.
√ May I borrow your pen? / √ Could you lend me your pen?

sections.p: come 表示朝说话人或听者移动，go 表示离开说话人；send 表示派人送或寄送，不强调伴随；carry 强调携带的动作与负重，不表示方向本身。
bullets: √ Come here and look at this. / × Go here.
√ I went to the library after class. / √ She came to see me yesterday.
√ I sent the documents by email. / √ He carried the box upstairs.
× Go here and help me. → Come here and help me.

examples.en: Please bring your ID card here tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天请把你的身份证带到这里来。
examples.note: here 是说话人所在处，朝参照点移动用 bring。

examples.en: Please take your ID card here tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天请把你的身份证带到这里来。
examples.note: take 表示离开说话人带走，与 here 指出的方向冲突，应改为 bring。

examples.en: She borrowed three books from the library.
examples.zh: 她从图书馆借了三本书。
examples.note: borrow 是借入，用 from 引出出借的一方。

examples.en: She borrowed me three books.
examples.zh: 她借给我三本书。
examples.note: borrow 不能带双宾语，借出用 lend sb sth。

examples.en: Could you fetch some chalk from the office?
examples.zh: 你能去办公室拿些粉笔来吗？
examples.note: fetch 含“去取再回来”的往返过程。

examples.en: He lent his camera to his cousin for the trip.
examples.zh: 他把相机借给表弟旅行用。
examples.note: lend sth to sb 表示借出，主语是给出者。

examples.en: Come to my office when you are free.
examples.zh: 你有空时到我办公室来。
examples.note: come 表示朝说话人所在处移动。

pitfalls.why: borrow 是借入，主语是取得者；把东西借给别人用 lend。

pitfalls.wrong: Please take your report here tomorrow.
pitfalls.right: Please bring your report here tomorrow.
pitfalls.why: here 是说话人所在处，朝参照点移动用 bring，take 表示带走。

pitfalls.wrong: I will borrow you my notes.
pitfalls.right: I will lend you my notes.
pitfalls.why: borrow 不能带双宾语，借出用 lend sb sth。

contrast.diff: 义近词的差别在能否带人、能否带 to 等句法槽位；方向动词的差别在动作朝向哪个参照点以及是否往返。

concept.mnemonic: bring 来、take 去、fetch 去取再来；borrow 借入、lend 借出；come 朝我、go 离开我。

core: bring 朝说话人或听者；take 离开说话人；fetch 去取再回来
borrow sth from sb 是借入；lend sb sth 是借出
borrow 不能带双宾语
come 朝说话人移动；go 离开说话人
send 强调寄送或派人，carry 强调携带动作
判断顺序：参照点 → 单向或往返 → 取得者或给出者
review.trigger: 看到 bring/take/fetch 或 borrow/lend → 先找 here/there、from/to 等参照信号

quickCheck.q: “我借给他一本书”用 borrow 还是 lend？
here 前面用 bring 还是 take？

drills.stem: Could you ___ me your notes for the weekend?
drills.answer: lend
drills.explain: 句意是“你把笔记借给我”，主语 you 是给出者，用 lend sb sth。
drills.trap: borrow 是借入，主语应是取得者，且不能带双宾语。

drills.stem: I ___ two novels from the school library yesterday. (borrow)
drills.answer: borrowed
drills.hint: 借入用 borrow，注意与 yesterday 的时态配合。
drills.explain: borrow sth from sb 表示借入，yesterday 要求一般过去时 borrowed。

drills.stem: She borrowed me her umbrella when it started to rain.
drills.answer: She lent me her umbrella when it started to rain.
accept: She lent me her umbrella when it started to rain.
drills.explain: 主语 she 是借出者，且结构为 lend sb sth，borrow 既方向相反又不能带双宾语。

drills.stem: Please ___ the documents here before noon.
drills.answer: bring
drills.explain: here 指说话人所在处，朝这一参照点移动用 bring。
drills.trap: take 表示从说话人这里带走，方向与 here 相反；fetch 强调去取再返回，carry 只强调携带动作。

drills.stem: 他昨天从图书馆借了三本书。
drills.answer: He borrowed three books from the library yesterday.
drills.explain: borrow 是借入，出借方由 from 引出；lent 是借出，方向相反。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Could you fetch me a glass of water?
drills.explain: fetch 表示去取再回来，可带双宾语 fetch sb sth；Could you 是委婉请求。

items.title: 副词辨析
items.brief: 同形副词与 -ly 副词意义相反

concept.summary: 副词辨析的核心是“同形副词”与“-ly 副词”的语义分工：hard 是“努力、猛烈”，hardly 是“几乎不”；late 是“迟”，lately 是“最近”；near 是“在附近”，nearly 是“几乎”。already/yet/still 的差别在时间参照与句法位置：already 用于肯定句，yet 用于否定与疑问，still 表示持续。

sections.p: hard 与 late 既是形容词也是副词，加 -ly 后不是简单的副词化，而是变成另一个词。hardly 是否定副词，位置在实义动词前、be 动词后；lately 意为“最近”，常与完成时连用。
bullets: √ She works hard every day. / × She works hardly every day.
√ I can hardly hear you. / × I can hard hear you.
√ He arrived late for the meeting. / √ He has been ill lately.
√ He has been busy lately. / × He has been busy late.

sections.p: near 作副词表示“在附近”，nearly 表示“几乎、差不多”；high 作副词表示具体高度，highly 表示抽象程度“高度地”。判断依据是后面的词是具体空间、高度，还是抽象性质。
bullets: √ The station is quite near. / √ We are nearly finished.
√ The kite flew high. / √ She is highly respected.
× I am near ready. → nearly ready
× He jumped highly. → jumped high

sections.p: already 表示“已经”，用于肯定句，位置在助动词后、实义动词前；yet 用于否定句与疑问句，通常置于句末；still 表示“仍然”，强调持续，位置在实义动词前、be 动词后。
bullets: √ She has already finished the report.
√ Have you finished the report yet?
√ He is still working on it.
√ She has already left. / × She has left yet.

examples.en: She works hard to support her family.
examples.zh: 她努力工作养家。
examples.note: hard 作副词意为“努力”，修饰 works。

examples.en: She works hardly to support her family.
examples.zh: 她努力工作养家。
examples.note: hardly 意为“几乎不”，与句意完全相反。

examples.en: He has been very busy lately.
examples.zh: 他最近很忙。
examples.note: lately 意为“最近”，与完成时连用。

examples.en: He has been very busy late.
examples.zh: 他最近很忙。
examples.note: late 表示“迟”，不能表示“最近”，应改为 lately。

examples.en: We are nearly ready to leave.
examples.zh: 我们差不多准备出发了。
examples.note: nearly 表示“几乎”，修饰 ready。

examples.en: Have you handed in your essay yet?
examples.zh: 你交论文了吗？
examples.note: yet 用于疑问句，置于句末。

examples.en: She has already handed in her essay.
examples.zh: 她已经交了论文。
examples.note: already 用于肯定句，位于助动词 has 之后。

pitfalls.wrong: I hardly can understand his handwriting.
pitfalls.right: I can hardly understand his handwriting.
pitfalls.why: hardly 是否定副词，须放在情态动词或助动词之后。
near 表示空间距离，表示“几乎”须用 nearly。

pitfalls.wrong: He has finished his homework yet.
pitfalls.right: He has not finished his homework yet.
pitfalls.why: yet 用于否定句与疑问句，肯定句表“已经”用 already。

contrast.withTitle: 副词与形容词的易混形式
contrast.diff: 形容词章节处理“该用形容词还是副词”的词性选择；本知识点处理两个副词都成立但意义不同的词对。

concept.mnemonic: hard 努力、hardly 几乎不；late 迟、lately 最近；near 附近、nearly 几乎；already 肯定、yet 否定疑问、still 持续。

core: hard 努力、hardly 几乎不，二者意义相反
late 迟、lately 最近；near 附近、nearly 几乎
high 具体高度、highly 抽象程度
already 用于肯定句，位于助动词后
yet 用于否定句与疑问句，置于句末
still 表示持续，位于实义动词前、be 动词后
review.trigger: 看到 -ly 副词 → 先查它是否与原形同义；看到 already/yet/still → 先判句式与时态

quickCheck.q: yet 通常出现在什么句式中？
quickCheck.a: 否定句与疑问句，置于句末。

drills.stem: She works ___ to support her family, taking two jobs at once.
drills.answer: hard
drills.explain: 句意为“努力工作养家”，hard 作副词表示“努力”，直接修饰 works。
drills.trap: hardly 是“几乎不”，会把句意变成“几乎不工作”，与 taking two jobs 矛盾。

drills.stem: I have not received his reply ___.
drills.answer: yet
drills.explain: yet 用于否定句，表示“还（没）”，通常置于句末；already 不能用于否定句。

drills.stem: He works hardly to improve his spoken English.
drills.answer: He works hard to improve his spoken English.
accept: He works hard to improve his spoken English.
drills.explain: hardly 意为“几乎不”，与“提高口语”的目的矛盾，应改为 hard“努力地”。

drills.stem: The old bridge is ___ finished, so we can use it next week.
drills.answer: nearly
drills.explain: nearly 表示“几乎、差不多”，修饰 finished，说明工程接近完成。
drills.trap: near 表示空间上的“近”，不能修饰 finished；hardly 是否定，与下周可用矛盾。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She has already booked the tickets for the concert.
drills.explain: already 用于肯定句，位置在助动词 has 之后、实义动词 booked 之前。

drills.stem: 我最近没有见过他。
drills.answer: I have not seen him lately.
drills.explain: “最近”用 lately，不用 late；现在完成时的否定结构是 have not seen。

items.title: 程度与范围词辨析
items.brief: 程度词看修饰对象与搭配限制

concept.summary: 程度词看被修饰成分的词性与句法功能：very 修饰形容词与副词原级，much 修饰比较级、too 和最高级；almost 表示“几乎、差一点”，mostly 表示“大多、主要地”；quite 表示“相当”，rather 常带“过于、出乎意料”的负面色彩，too 表示“过度”并引出否定结果。

sections.p: very 修饰形容词与副词原级，不能直接修饰动词或比较级；much 修饰比较级、too、最高级，也可修饰不可数名词。修饰动词时用 very much，位置在句末或宾语之后。
bullets: √ She is very careful. / × She is much careful.
√ This box is much heavier. / × This box is very heavier.
√ I like the design very much. / × I very like the design.
√ He is much too busy to see you.

sections.p: almost 表示“几乎、差一点”，修饰可分级形容词、数量词和动词，不能直接修饰名词；mostly 表示“大部分地、主要地”，修饰谓语或整个状态，相当于 mainly。
bullets: √ Almost all the students passed. / × Most all the students passed.
√ Almost all the guests were teachers. / × Mostly all the guests were teachers.
√ I almost missed the train. / √ The room is mostly used for storage.
× The students were almost from the countryside. → mostly
√ The audience was mostly students. / × The audience was almost students.

sections.p: quite 表示“相当、完全”，语气中性；rather 修饰形容词时多含“过于、出乎意料”的负面评价；too 表示“过度”，常与 to do 搭配引出否定结果。
bullets: √ The film was quite interesting. / √ The film was rather boring.
√ It is rather cold today.（偏冷，含不满）/ √ It is quite cold today.（相当冷，中性）
√ The coffee is too hot to drink. / √ The coffee is quite hot.（too 才引出“不能喝”的结果）
√ The bag is rather heavy for a child.

examples.en: The final exam was much harder than we had expected.
examples.zh: 期末考试比我们预想的难得多。
examples.note: much 修饰比较级 harder。

examples.en: The final exam was very harder than we had expected.
examples.zh: 期末考试比我们预想的难得多。
examples.note: very 不能修饰比较级，须用 much。

examples.en: I enjoyed the concert very much.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢这场音乐会。
examples.note: 修饰动词 enjoyed 用 very much，置于宾语之后。

examples.en: Almost all the seats had been taken.
examples.zh: 几乎所有座位都被占了。
examples.note: almost 修饰数量词 all。

examples.en: The audience was mostly made up of students.
examples.zh: 观众大多是学生。
examples.note: mostly 表示构成比例上的“大多”。

examples.en: The audience was almost made up of students.
examples.zh: 观众大多是学生。
examples.note: almost 表示“几乎”，不能表示比例上的“大多数”。

examples.en: The instructions were rather confusing.
examples.zh: 这些说明相当令人费解。
examples.note: rather 带“出乎意料、偏负面”的评价色彩。

pitfalls.right: I like this song very much.
pitfalls.why: very 不能直接修饰动词，修饰动词须用 very much 并置于句末。

pitfalls.wrong: This problem is very more difficult.
pitfalls.right: This problem is much more difficult.
pitfalls.why: very 不能修饰比较级，比较级前的程度词用 much、far、even。

pitfalls.wrong: The students were almost from the countryside.
pitfalls.right: The students were mostly from the countryside.
pitfalls.why: almost 表“几乎”不表比例；表示“大多数”用 mostly。

contrast.diff: 比较级修饰语只讲 much/far/even 等能放在比较级前的词；本知识点还覆盖 very/much 的分工与 almost/mostly 的范围差别。

concept.mnemonic: very 修饰原级、much 修饰比较级；almost 差一点、mostly 大多数；rather 带不满。

core: very 修饰形容词、副词原级，不修饰动词和比较级
much 修饰比较级、too、最高级；修饰动词用 very much
almost 表示“几乎、差一点”，可修饰 all、数量与动词
mostly 表示“大多、主要地”，相当于 mainly
quite 中性“相当”，rather 常带负面评价
too 表示“过度”，常与 to do 搭配
review.trigger: 看到程度词 → 先看它修饰的是原级、比较级还是动词 → 再查 almost/mostly 是“几乎”还是“大多”

quickCheck.q: “观众大多是学生”用 almost 还是 mostly？

drills.stem: The new model is ___ more expensive than the old one.
drills.answer: much
drills.explain: more expensive 是比较级，前面只能用 much、far、even 等程度词，不能用 very。
drills.trap: very 只能修饰原级；too 与 so 也不能直接修饰比较级 more expensive。

drills.stem: By the time we arrived, ___ all the seats had been taken.
drills.answer: almost
drills.explain: almost 修饰数量词 all，表示“几乎所有”，放在 all 之前。

drills.stem: I very enjoyed the lecture on urban history.
drills.answer: I enjoyed the lecture on urban history very much.
accept: I enjoyed the lecture on urban history very much.
drills.explain: very 不能直接修饰动词，修饰 enjoyed 须用 very much 并置于宾语之后。

drills.stem: The village is ___ populated by retired farmers.
drills.answer: mostly
drills.explain: 句意是“村民大多是退休农民”，表示构成比例用 mostly。
drills.trap: almost 表示“几乎”，不能表示人口构成上的“大多数”；very 与 much 也不能修饰 populated 的这一含义。

drills.stem: 这道题比那道题难得多。
drills.answer: This question is much more difficult than that one.
drills.explain: 比较级前用 much 表程度，difficult 的比较级是 more difficult，不能再加 -er。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The instructions were rather confusing for beginners.
drills.explain: rather 修饰 confusing，带“相当、偏负面”的评价；for beginners 说明评价的适用范围。
